knowledge_gaps: The padding audit is justified, but the actual GRU implementation is unavailable. Reported discrepancies do not establish whether recurrence, readout, preprocessing, or numerical execution causes them. Define a reference computation and freeze acceptance thresholds before deciding on repair.

Repeated identical executions alone cannot calibrate systematic differences between packed, batched, and individual execution. Include a padding-skipping reference using identical weights and explicit precision settings.

Packing can change dropout draws and execution order during training. Specify embedding/dropout placement, multilayer behavior, row sorting and restoration, differentiable output scattering, and all-empty-batch handling.

The report replaces the original three-condition cropping experiment with a prerequisite audit but gives no explicit continuation rule. State when to resume A/B/C and apply any necessary correction uniformly across conditions.

Reproduction requires a fixed epoch count, checkpoint-selection rule, remaining-budget estimate, complete four-category comparison, and tie-breaking rule. No validation improvement is yet demonstrated. The originality rating is reasonable; potential 8 and difficulty 4 remain provisional.
